item.text: {"search_note":"I found no reliable evidence that Scholz manipulated electoral law, court rulings, election administration, security forces, media regulation, or public spending to entrench himself in 2024. The evidence base is mostly the opposite: orderly trust-vote process, due-process language, and institutional handling of crises. The best counterevidence is structural rather than personal: overbroad surveillance powers and general political instability, not a demonstrated self-entrenchment scheme.","evidence":[{"title":"Regierungserklärung von Bundeskanzler Olaf Scholz","publisher":"Bundesregierung","date":"2024-11-13","url":"https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-de/suche/regierungserklaerung-von-bundeskanzler-olaf-scholz-2320314","summary":"Scholz said he would request a confidence vote, accepted an orderly democratic process, and said citizens should decide how the country should continue.
